# nomatron_agent (Resource)

Nomatron agent resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_agent" "example" {
  name        = "test-agent"
  description = "A Terraform-provisioned agent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the agent.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the agent.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the agent is active.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the agent was created.
- `created_by_id` (String) ID of the actor that created the agent, when available.
- `created_by_type` (String) Type of actor that created the agent.
- `id` (String) Agent ID.
